title: BEAR-Bench: A Bilingual Enterprise and Academic Reasoning Benchmark for Multimodal Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.17895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made significant strides in visual comprehension, their ability to reason about text-dense, professional documents remains incompletely evaluated. Existing benchmarks emphasize information extraction, require external domain knowledge, or cover professional documents only as one of many settings. They are also largely English- or Chinese-centric, leaving other languages and Russian, in particular, substantially underrepresented. To address these limitations, we introduce BEAR-Bench (Bilingual Enterprise and Academic Reasoning), a self-contained, complex English-and-Russian benchmark comprising 1000 human-annotated questions based on text-rich business and scientific documents. translated_title: BEAR-Bench：面向多模态模型的双语企业与学术推理基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17895v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉理解方面取得了显著进展，但它们在处理文本密集、专业文档方面的推理能力仍未得到充分评估。现有基准侧重于信息提取，需要外部领域知识，或将专业文档仅作为众多场景之一来覆盖。此外，这些基准大多以英语或中文为中心，导致其他语言，尤其是俄语，代表性严重不足。为解决这些局限性，我们引入了BEAR-Bench（双语企业与学术推理基准），这是一个自包含的、复杂的英俄双语基准，包含基于文本丰富的商业和科学文档的1000个人工标注问题。我们在BEAR-Bench上评估了16个专有和开源权重的MLLMs，包括Gemini 3.1 Pro和Qwen3.5-397B，并观察到即使是最强大的系统也存在明显的提升空间。最后，我们利用所得模型输出进行了进一步分析。
tldr: BEAR-Bench是一个全新的英俄双语基准，包含1000个基于专业商业和科学文档的人工标注问题，用于评估多模态大语言模型在文本密集场景下的推理能力，并揭示了当前最强模型仍存在显著性能提升空间。
en_tdlr: BEAR-Bench is a new bilingual English-Russian benchmark with 1,000 human-annotated questions based on professional business and scientific documents, designed to evaluate multimodal LLMs' reasoning in text-dense scenarios, revealing significant headroom even for the strongest models.
